field_examples.comments:
Source: [TIA](https://archive.org/details/designsonprehist00fewk_0/page/n3/mode/2up).

This project was previously run as a chapter out of a larger Bureau of American Ethnology volume. It was also published as a standalone volume, which is this project. (A page by page overlay proved they were exact matches: not that it matters since this is being rerun through the rounds. The only difference was the title page/chapter title page.) 

Note: Because the standalone reprint was taken from the larger volume, the Government Printing Office did ***not*** do any new typesetting to renumber the pages. The Table of Contents starts on book page 209.

Proofers, because this is a retreaded* project, you may find some formatting markup in the project. Feel free to remove all the formatting so you can accurately proof around it. 

Post Processor: [The large plate at the end of the book is color](https://www.pgdp.net/projects/projectID3fc3d7d03c613/facing276b.jpg), please take care in processing it.

*Retread means this project started life in the early days of DP when formatting and proofing were done in the same rounds. There were issues such as the missing images and some poor proofing images which left it parked and unable to be Post Processed at that time.

This project is a Second Pass project, meaning it is being cycled through P1 a second time.

{P1->P1} has been added to the title—all P1ers are welcome to work on either pass but please work in only one of them so that each page gets seen by two individuals for the round. Give particular attention to subtle errors, such as stealth scannos and comma/period errors.

Please use WordCheck on every page!
